svg.title: Agent Remote Control
svg.desc: Your AI dev team, one message away. A message from your phone reaches the CEO agent, which delegates to the Product Owner, Tech Lead, Developer, Code Reviewer and Git Ops agents while a Discord thread shows each step finishing, up to an opened pull request.

g.text: SELF-HOSTED · BRING YOUR OWN AGENT · OPEN SOURCE
Your AI dev team, one message away.
@ARC in my-backend, add a password reset endpoint that sends an email, then open a PR
Product Owner · acceptance criteria written: token expires in 30 min, rate-limited per email
Tech Lead · 4-step plan approved: route, service, email template, tests
Developer · implemented on feature/password-reset, 18 tests added, suite passing
Code Reviewer · no blocking issues, 2 suggestions applied
Git Ops · pushed and opened pull request #42
Done! The reset flow is on feature/password-reset and PR #42 is ready for review.
